name: Should I choose turf or real grass for a backyard remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose artificial turf or real grass for a backyard renovation in Southern California?
mainEntity.text: Should I choose artificial turf or real grass for a backyard renovation in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial turf and real grass solve different problems. Turf is often chosen in Los Angeles because it reduces watering and mowing and keeps a cleaner look in high-use areas. Real grass can feel softer and cooler, but it usually needs more irrigation, maintenance, and recovery time, especially in shaded or heavily used yards. Before choosing, homeowners should consider pet use, drainage, sun exposure, heat, and how much of the yard will be reserved for lounging, playing, or entertaining. Turf can be a strong option in small or complicated yards where maintaining a lawn is difficult. Real grass may be better for larger, softer play areas or where the homeowner wants a classic landscape feel. The right answer often comes down to lifestyle rather than aesthetics alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf usually needs less water and less routine maintenance, while real grass offers a natural look and cooler surface. The better choice depends on sun exposure, drainage, pets, how the yard will be used, and whether the homeowner wants a low-maintenance space.
